name: Places
author: Qissa Studio
description: Full-screen places: inside a masjid, a village, desert dunes with a caravan, a spring meadow, an autumn park, a snowy village, a mountain cave at night and the seashore. The ground is at about y 1360-1400; the colours are the sky (they set the text colour).

backgrounds.description: Inside a masjid: arches, mihrab, lamps and a red carpet with prayer rows
A village of mud houses and palm trees by day, with a path
Desert dunes at dusk with a camel caravan on the horizon
Green spring meadow with flowers, a tree and white clouds
Autumn park: orange trees, falling leaves and a path
Snowy village in winter with warm lit windows and falling snow
Rocky mountain with a cave mouth under a starry night (Hira, Thawr)
Sandy shore by a blue sea with a sailing boat (Yunus, travel)
